dataset: Public Inscriptions from Palmyra: catalogue rows, names and buildings

source.work: Raja, Rubina; Steding, Julia; Yon, Jean-Baptiste; Romanowska, Iza. 2026. Public Inscriptions from Palmyra. Zenodo.
source.data_paper: Steding, Romanowska, Yon and Raja 2026, Journal of Open Archaeology Data, doi:10.5334/joad.189

scope_note: Catalogue data and names. The dataset holds no inscription text. Names are the editors' vocalised romanisation; no consonantal spelling is given or derived.

rules.cells: Trimmed of surrounding whitespace; nothing else changed.
rules.ids: PAT number (digits padded to four), else IGLS, CIS, RES, else the sheet row.
rules.sigla: As the sheet gives them, under the dataset's own column names; the IGLS volume is not stated in the sheet.
rules.names: One row per filled Founder_n and Ind_n cell of the Names sheet, one per IndA-IndQ cell of the main sheet with its function, one per comma-separated entry of the Gods column (which also holds deified emperors and 'Anonymous God').
rules.buildings: building_id is set when the record's building_name equals a building's name exactly.
rules.concordance: concordance.jsonl: one row per inscription that carries more than one siglum, with keys pat:N, igls:N, cis:N, res:N (zeros dropped) for lookup. The equations are the dataset's own columns.
